fit.qualification: BEFORE starting any new DEV actions, actually run unchanged C25 NativeActive on original FIT-only source episodes. Require at least one real source public information-seeking turn revealing previously unknown blocked-front status. Only evaluator observes outcome label to qualify experiment; policy may use only normal returned public signal. If absent, stop immediately; no DEV identities consumed.

intervention: For every actual information-gathering turn chosen during a native or independent conventional original-source DEV episode, create evaluator-only deep cloned original wrapped source and exact previously learned public agent, with matching world RNG before step. Run three original-source outcome branches from that moment: A information-facing actual 90° turn with genuine subsequent public front reading, B same physical information-facing 90° turn, identical source outcome, with ONLY the post-turn newly revealed front blocked/clear reading intentionally replaced by optimistic-clear for one subsequent planning decision and no permanent synthetic update, C opposite 90° turn toward previously observed edge (same physical action cost but different heading and route, so physical confounding). Subsequent policy choices disable new artificial probes, use original native R3+selective memory or independently learned conventional Beta control with only own actual source consequences. Source/agent clones NEVER visible to any policy; original environment source logs all actions and rewards.
selection: All actually proposed DEV information-facing turns on the non-forked original active parent trajectory, not only blocked outcomes, max 12 forks per source episode for bounded resource cost. Log each real postturn public front status (blocked or clear) and analyze stratified. Do not select only positive postturn outcomes; do not tune from exposed C25/C26 DEV. FIT qualification happens on distinct FIT only.
scientific_gates: FIT source screen contains >=1 surprising blocked-front after authentic selected information action before any new DEV
Full physical A/B source first-action observation/reward identical at every fork
If both blocked and clear DEV outcome strata unavailable, archive as partially diagnostic and no general claim
Compare first follow-on selected physical action and actual long-horizon reward/goals A vs B; only A vs B isolates immediate observation use with fixed first motion
Compare actual matched-turn C to A for route changes, explicitly confounded by changed heading
Archive every original public step+reward trace with source identities, source seed restricted from policy
Two independent complete whole-program runs each arm yield identical fit qualification, source actions, goal outcomes, cold-persisted checkpoint digests
Fresh OS restored full native and conventional belief state must choose same next public action; resource cost CPU+RSS+checkpoint bytes
No native superiority without stronger conventional controls; no protected independent first-use/owner edits
governance: Independently authored Mass Research draft; unchanged source owner original R1/R2/R3; no FORGE/CKB write ownership, no paid APIs, no library uploads, no merge/promotion.
